derivation: from a compound of G3717 (ὀρθός) and G4228 (πούς);
def: to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward

occurrences.text: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
